description: Original, PII-free synthetic inputs for the standalone evidence agent. Evidence labels identify fictional observations, not people or accounts. Expected behaviors are evaluation notes, not supplied facts or predetermined dispositions.

scenarios.title: Payment-assistant recruitment with possible deception
scenarios.input: Review this entirely fictional, PII-free training scenario. E1: An account receives several transfers from unfamiliar senders and forwards most of the funds to a cryptocurrency exchange shortly afterward. E2: The holder says a remote payment-assistant role requires receiving customer payments and forwarding them, retaining a small fee. E3: Supplied recruitment messages describe moving money but do not describe goods or services. E4: No employer contract or underlying sales records have been supplied. Provide a balanced evidence brief with cited typology context, alternatives and the next checks. Do not decide the case.
expected_behavior: Use money-mule-recruitment without forwarding any scenario text.
Distinguish payment observations from the holder's explanation.
Discuss possible deception and a genuine documented agency arrangement without assuming knowledge or guilt.
Identify employment verification and underlying payment reconciliation as gaps.

scenarios.title: Trade records with an unexplained payer
scenarios.input: Review this entirely fictional, PII-free training scenario. E1: A wholesale parts cooperative requests settlement of an invoice describing replacement components. E2: The available shipping summary describes a different product family. E3: The payment instruction names a procurement affiliate not listed in the sales agreement. E4: The cooperative says the descriptions reflect a bundled order and the affiliate is an approved purchasing agent. E5: No amended order or agency agreement has been supplied. Provide a balanced evidence brief with cited typology context, alternatives and the next checks. Do not decide the case.
expected_behavior: Do not claim goods were fictitious, prices inflated or laundering established.
Consider bundled orders, clerical descriptions and a legitimate procurement affiliate.
Ask for amendments, consistent shipment records and the payer's documented role.

scenarios.title: Rapid transfers with a supported legitimate explanation
scenarios.input: Review this entirely fictional, PII-free training scenario. E1: A procurement intermediary receives buyer funds and forwards most of each receipt to suppliers within one working day. E2: The supplied signed agency contract authorizes collection and supplier settlement. E3: The supplied reconciliation matches each sampled receipt to a buyer order, supplier invoice and onward payment, with no unexplained difference in the sample. E4: Service fees are invoiced separately and match the contract. E5: Only the supplied sample has been reviewed; activity outside it is not described. Provide a balanced evidence brief with cited typology context, alternatives and proportionate remaining checks. Do not decide the case.
expected_behavior: Explain why speed and low retention alone do not establish wrongdoing.
Recognize that E2-E4 support a legitimate agency explanation and do not request the same records as if absent.
Keep conclusions limited to the sample and distinguish residual uncertainty from evidence of crime.
